attribution.changes: selected single-camera RGB and prospective automatic-mask/point diagnostic; original reference files unchanged

automatic_bank.query_rule: fixed 4x4 native XYWH bbox grid, floor/clamp/unique row-major pixels inside original mask; (anchor,y+.5,x+.5)

decision.nonregression: B wrong-object-class fraction <=A separately on EACH clip, SAME possible denominator
decision.otherwise: REJECT; retain all clips/queries/predictions/diagnostics; no repeat/filter/prompt/model/threshold changes
decision.primary: QUALIFIED_SEMANTIC_MASK_POINT_RETENTION only if B correct-supported fraction strictly>A separately on EACH clip
decision.unsupported_reference: zero object-referenced possible slots on either clip => INCONCLUSIVE

metrics.A: static original anchor XY diagnostic with all-true nominal support; not an admissible reconstructed trajectory
metrics.B: unchanged full-T Boots original-image XY and native_visible
metrics.coverage_floor: none; full natural occlusion is valid, missing remains penalized in primary denominator
metrics.dependence: seeds/hierarchy/anchors/queries correlated, not independent objects or trials
metrics.evaluation_frames: strict t>query_anchor only; prebirth and forced anchor remain stored but excluded
metrics.primary_correct_supported: native_visible AND finite AND in-original-image AND semantic SEG at floor predicted XY equals fixed object reference
metrics.primary_weighting: per clip micro counts over ALL object-referenced query-future-frame slots; no query/seed/frame selection
metrics.secondary_weighting: equal eligible seed/anchor macro plus every raw per-query count; Q0/NO_FUTURE reported separately
metrics.unknown_GT: INCONCLUSIVE whole experiment, never silently shrink denominator
metrics.wrong_object_class: supported finite in-bounds point lies in a different object class; background/HAND/missing counted separately

private_evaluation.class_catalog: 0-based original object_classes; HAND in native name is evaluator-only hand label
private_evaluation.class_name_dtype: native fixed-width Unicode/bytes; strict textual catalog match, no objects/pickle
private_evaluation.duplicate_same_class_objects: physical identity cannot be resolved; no Hungarian or instance-ID claim
private_evaluation.mapping: 0 is background; enumerate sorted unique positive SEG values, kth maps to obj_class_inds[k],obj_class_names[k]; never SEG==class_index+1
mapping_checks: unique semantic rows within each label
same class index/name identity across all selected frames
private_evaluation.mapping_failure: INCONCLUSIVE whole experiment, preserve missing/unknown/malformed counts; no predicted background substitute
private_evaluation.seg_dtype: native non-boolean NumPy signed/unsigned integer; 2D original H,W; no cast/resize/relabel

seed_reference.Q0: NO_QUERIES count retained, no score1 or zero-error success
seed_reference.initial_background_and_HAND: contamination diagnostics, never accepted actors or targets
seed_reference.last_anchor: NO_FUTURE; retain slots and raw predictions, no artificial perfect score
seed_reference.mixed_overlapping_masks: retain all queries/variants, report purity/class histogram/overlap; never choose best seed or variants
seed_reference.reference: fixed semantic (class_index,class_name) for all later frames
seed_reference.selection: every original query pixel at its frozen anchor, floor continuous original XY without rounding/fitting; evaluator-only SEG lookup

tracking.native_preprocessing: utils.bilinear align_corners=False; RGB /255*2-1; convert_grid_coordinates tyx then native XY256->original multiply-then-divide
